data.written: 2026-10-12, pin 14 v4 stage A (FAILURE_LOG F33): v3's whole-frame body-only edit failed the pose gate in both pictures (v1_0r moved the arms and drew his skin light peach and the janeu hanging straight down; v2_0r re-framed and zoomed in): on this pin the head is small and the torso large, so Gemini had the whole frame to redraw. v4 is a region edit of the torso and arms only: the crop of the pin (box 0.163-0.645 x 0.535-0.925, pin pixels 119-474 x 519-898, from above the trapezius at picture-left to below the hands) is sent at 2x (710x758; in v2's whole-frame return his torso was 365 px tall and read smooth). tools/region_edit.py pastes the return back only inside the pin man's YOLO person mask (tools/background_restore.yolo_masks, grown 10 px) below the neck line, with a soft mask that is 0 above the neck line and ramps to 1 over 10 px below it, so the head, the cap, the neck, the sky, the coast and the frame keep the pin's pixels exactly; the lower half of the pin man's face at the crop's top-right (jaw, cheek, nose tip) is never pasted. References: HIS BODY (pumped_front.jpg, the user's approved pumped front, cut to the torso below the beard and above the waistband logo) and v3's three crops of his own side-lit photos (arm and veins IMG_7005, chest/waist/janeu/chain IMG_7008, skin and body hair IMG_7002), each labelled for what it shows, never for pose. No face word: the paste never reaches his head; stage B swaps the head. The pin is a direct front view, not a mirror: his left shoulder is at picture-right, his right hip at picture-left, so the janeu runs from upper picture-right to lower picture-left (F33: Gemini drew it hanging straight down, so the item says once that it is never that). The tattoos, the bangle and the rings are the pin man's (his marks: none). After the run: paste each return (tools/region_edit.py paste-run with this crop), a difference map against the pin (only his body below the neck changed), the pose gate, and his body beside pumped_front and his side-lit photos at one scale.
